description: Defines the HttpVaryData class used for handling HTTP/1.1 Vary header data, including MD5 hashing of request headers and request matching logic.

classes.name: HttpVaryData
classes.description: Handles MD5 hashing of request headers indicated by the Vary header and provides request matching functionality.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the vary data is valid.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes vary data from request and response headers.

methods.name: InitFromPickle
methods.description: Initializes vary data from a serialized pickle.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Serializes the vary data into a pickle.

methods.name: MatchesRequest
methods.description: Checks if a request matches the stored vary data.
